mentions.name: imageguard
mentions.description: A lightweight Python library that checks whether an image is good enough to feed into an AI pipeline. Users pass in an image path and get back a decision, with no image-processing knowledge required.
mentions.problem: Vetting images for AI pipelines normally requires image-processing knowledge; this library makes it a simple pass-in-a-path, get-a-decision check.
mentions.audience: Developers building AI pipelines who don't want to deal with image-processing knowledge.
